name: week
title: Commissions this week
subtitle: What needs doing before the next payroll, rendered by npm run view

sections.title: Needs attention
sections.note: Overdue locks, old disputes, clawbacks not applied, close issues and compliance breaches.
sections.sql: select 'Period past month end, not locked' as item, name as about, (current_date - ends_on) || ' days since month end' as why from comm.periods where status = 'open' and ends_on < current_date union all select 'Clawback not applied', payee, deal || ' cancelled ' || cancelled_on from comm.clawback_queue union all select 'Close issue: ' || issue, item, period || ': ' || coalesce(detail, '') from comm.close_issues union all select 'Compliance: ' || rule, coalesce(payee, ''), finding from comm.compliance_findings where severity = 'breached'

sections.title: Attainment this month
sections.note: Credited value against monthly quota, and commission earned so far.
sections.sql: select payee, plan, currency, quota_cents, credited_cents, attainment_pct as attainment, (commission_cents + adjustments_cents) as earned_cents from comm.period_commission where current_date between (select starts_on from comm.periods where id = period_id) and (select ends_on from comm.periods where id = period_id) order by attainment_pct desc

sections.title: Open disputes
sections.sql: select y.name as payee, p.name as period, s.owner, (current_date - s.raised_on) as days_open, s.detail from comm.disputes s join comm.payees y on y.id = s.payee_id join comm.periods p on p.id = s.period_id where s.status = 'open' order by s.raised_on

name: finance
title: Commission accruals and contract costs
subtitle: For the month-end close: what is owed, what is on cost, what to capitalise

sections.title: Owed but not yet paid, by currency
sections.sql: select p.name as period, p.status, po.currency, count(*)::int as payees, sum(po.total_cents)::bigint as amount_cents, sum(po.super_due_cents)::bigint as super_due_cents from comm.payouts po join comm.periods p on p.id = po.period_id where p.status = 'locked' or (p.status = 'paid' and po.super_due_cents > 0 and po.super_paid_on is null) group by p.name, p.status, po.currency order by p.name

sections.title: Earned in open periods
sections.sql: select period, currency, sum(commission_cents + adjustments_cents)::bigint as earned_cents from comm.period_commission where status = 'open' group by period, currency order by period, currency

sections.title: Commission cost as a share of credited sales
sections.sql: select period, team, currency, round(100.0 * sum(commission_cents + adjustments_cents) / nullif(sum(credited_cents), 0), 1) as cost_pct from comm.period_commission group by period, team, currency order by period desc, team
